clues.text: Joseph's brothers sold him for twenty shekels of silver to Ishmaelites, who took him here.
During the great famine, ten of Joseph's brothers traveled down to this land to buy grain.
An angel told Joseph in a dream to take the Child and His mother and flee here from Herod.
When Aaron stretched out his hand over its waters, frogs came up and covered this land.
When a severe famine struck, Abram went down to live in this land for a while.
Complaining in the wilderness, Israel remembered the fish, cucumbers, melons and leeks they ate freely here.
The Israelites stayed in this land for 430 years before the LORD brought them out.

taken: His brothers pulled him out of a pit and sold him to Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver.
When Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, these came up and covered the land.
Abram went down to Egypt with Sarai because this had become severe in the land.
